options.name: attached
options.description: If true, the volume will be attached to a Linode. Otherwise, the volume will be detached.

options.name: config_id
options.description: When creating a Volume attached to a Linode, the ID of the Linode Config to include the new Volume in.

options.name: encryption
options.description: Enables encryption on the volume. Full disk encryption ensures the data stored on a block storage volume drive is secure.

options.name: label
options.description: The Volume’s label, which is also used in the filesystem_path of the resulting volume.

options.name: linode_id
options.description: The Linode this volume should be attached to upon creation. If not given, the volume will be created without an attachment.

options.name: region
options.description: The location to deploy the volume in. See https://api.linode.com/v4/regions

options.name: size
options.description: The size of this volume, in GB. Be aware that volumes may only be resized up after creation.

options.name: source_volume_id
options.description: The volume id of the desired volume to clone.

options.name: state
options.description: The desired state of the target.

options.name: tags
options.description: The tags to be attached to the volume.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: The amount of time, in seconds, to wait for a volume to have the active status.
